correctness.rationale: The reciprocal change y=1/x yields translations Q_b(y)=y-b and square-root flows C_a(y)=sqrt(y²−2a), all increasing on physical positive domains. Cyclic adjacent equal-type windows merge; the only irreducible four-letter word is alternating and has fixed-point necessity reducible to a quadratic, with an identically vanishing polynomial producing only a locally identity return, hence no isolated fixed point. For <=3 windows the reduced equation is linear. For the four-pulse example, the exact concave g_d(y) has one interior maximum and g_d(0) crossing at d∞, furnishing 1/2/one double/0 finite positive roots. Direct exact Fraction recomputation verified y=1/2 and 7/6 at d=1, with derivatives 9/7 and 143/161; independent parameter root counts corroborated. Physical positivity after each pulse, the excluded y=0 boundary and smooth local persistence were explicitly checked against the proof.
